submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Produce one opaque full-bleed native1254-square game-map detail for r09_c08/r03_c04. Image1 gives exact framing, scale and existing object footprints. The TOP115 rows and RIGHTMOST115 columns are native neighbor references: preserve existing contours, grooves, materials and shadow endpoints at their exact coordinates; north wins the shared top-right corner. Rows115..229 and columns1024..1138 contain guide-only soft transitions into regional context. Rebuild those into continuous painting; never copy guide bounds as walls, steps, dark bars, abrupt texture changes or truncated grooves. Reconstruct the soft interior as crisp native detail. Image2 is the user-approved primary painting/material style: bright, clean, rounded, full-bodied Daoist chibi fantasy with smooth readable bevels and restrained low-contrast surfaces. Copy no UI, text, symbols, floral ornaments, characters, lighting or objects from Image2. Keep ONLY objects and materials already present in Image1; no additions, recropping, repositioning, rotation or enlargement. Quiet ivory stone: no grit, cracks, veins, stains, bright scored scratches, harsh brush patches, blur or sharpening halos. Rounded clean existing leaves. No new buildings, stairs, medallions, frames, labels or watermark. Return only this single native detail image.
Actual visible crop inventory: quiet open ivory pavement only, with ONE existing broad shallow curved paving groove crossing the very bottom of the image from the lower-left and leaving through the bottom near the right. Preserve that exact groove's location, width and smooth white bevel. There are no trees, blossoms, lamps, posts, shadows or other objects in this square; add none. Do not invent any grid, new groove, vertical connector, fine diagonal scored line, fading scratch or extra border. Stone has subtle broad low-contrast painterly variation, never a high-contrast checker. The actual top and far-right native context must connect seamlessly to the repainted interior. Keep exact crop scale and existing bottom groove geometry.
